snp4.13:1.1: NIṬṬHITAṂ. Mahāviyūhasutta. "Ye kec' ime diṭṭhi paribbasānā ‘idam eva saccan' ti vivādiyanti, sabbe va te nindam anvānayanti atho pasaṃsam pi labhanti tattha". || ||
snp4.13:2.1: "Appaṃ hi etaṃ na alaṃ samāya, duve vivādassa phalāni brūmi, etam pi disvā na vivādiyetha khemābhipassaṃ avivādabhūmiṃ. || ||
snp4.13:3.1: Yā kāc' imā sammutiyo puthujjā, sabbā va etā na upeti vidvā, anūpayo so upayaṃ kim eyya diṭṭhe sute khantim akubbamāno. || ||
snp4.13:4.1: Sīluttamā saññamenāhu suddhiṃ vataṃ samādāya upaṭṭhitāse ‘idh' eva sikkema, ath' assa suddhiṃ' bhavūpanītā kusalā vadānā. || ||
snp4.13:5.1: Sace cuto sīlavatāto hoti, sa vedhati kammaṃ virādhayitvā, sa jappati paṭṭhayatīdha suddhiṃ satthā va hīno pavasaṃ gharamhā. || ||
snp4.13:6.1: Sīlabbataṃ vāpi pahāya sabbaṃ kammañ ca sāvajjanavajjam etaṃ| ‘suddhī, asuddhī' ti apattayāno virato care santim anuggahāya. || ||
snp4.13:7.1: Tapūpanissāya jigucchitaṃ vā atha vā pi diṭṭhaṃ va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā uddhaṃsarā suddhim anutthuṇanti avītataṇhāse bhavābhavesu. || ||
snp4.13:8.1: Patthayamānassa hi jappitāni saṃvedhitaṃ cāpi pakappitesu: cutūpapāto idha yassa n' atthi, sa kena vedheyya kuhiñ ca jappe. || ||
snp4.13:9.1: "Yam āhu dhammaṃ ‘paraman' ti {eke}, tam eva ‘hīnan' ti panāhu aññe: sacco nu vādo katamo imesaṃ, sabbe va hīme kusalā vadānā. || ||
snp4.13:10.1: Sakaṃ hi dhammaṃ paripuṇṇam āhu *aññassa dhammaṃ pana hīnam āhu,* evam pi viggayha vivādiyanti sakaṃ sakaṃ sammutim āhu saccaṃ". || ||
snp4.13:11.1: "Parassa ce vambhayitena hīno, na koci dhammesu visesi assa, puthū hi aññassa vadanti dhammaṃ nihīnato samhi daḷhaṃ vadānā. || ||
snp4.13:12.1: Sadhammapūjā ca panā tath' eva: yathā pasaṃsanti sakāyanāni, sabbe va vādā thathivā bhaveyyuṃ, suddhī hi nesaṃ paccattam eva. || ||
snp4.13:13.1: Na brāhmaṇassa paraneyyam atthi dhammesu niccheyya samuggahītaṃ, tasmā vivādāni upātivatto, na hi seṭṭhato passati dhammam aññaṃ. || ||
snp4.13:14.1: ‘Jānāmi passāmi, tath' eva etaṃ' diṭṭhiyā eke paccenti suddhiṃ: addakkhi ce, kiṃ hi tumassa tena, atisitvā aññena vadantī suddhiṃ. || ||
snp4.13:15.1: Passaṃ naro dakkhiti nāmarūpaṃ, disvāna vāññassati tāni-m-eva: kāmaṃ bahuṃ passatu appakaṃ vā, na hi tena suddhiṃ kusalā vadanti. || ||
snp4.13:16.1: Nivissavādī na hi suddhināyo pakappitaṃ diṭṭhi purekkharāno, yaṃ nissito, tattha subhaṃ vadāno suddhiṃvado tattha tath' addasā so. || ||
snp4.13:17.1: Na brāhmaṇo kappam upeti saṃkhaṃ na diṭṭhisārī na pi ñāṇabandhu,| ñatvā ca so sammutiyo puthujjā upekhati, uggahaṇanta-m-aññe. || ||
snp4.13:18.1: Visajja ganthāni munīdha loke vivādajātesu na vaggasārī santo asantesu upekkhako so anuggaho, uggahaṇanta-m-aññe. || ||
snp4.13:19.1: Pubbāsave hitvā nave akubbaṃ na chandagū no pi nivissavādo, sa vippamutto diṭṭhigatehi dhīro na lippati loke anattagarahī. || ||
snp4.13:20.1: Sa sabbadhammesu visenibhūto, yaṃ kiñci diṭṭhaṃ va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā, sa pannabhāro muni vippayutto na kappiyo nūparato na patthiyo" ti Bhagavā ti || || MAHĀVIYŪHASUTTAṂ
